description:
The four named icon bundles are gone, and a repository that wants any of them declares it per type through the map that already exists.

## Background

Four named bundles of type icons are selectable by name from the configuration and answered through the hierarchy endpoint. A named bundle of content selected by name is exactly the shape the boundary excludes, and the per-type custom map already expresses any of the four, so removing them removes no capability.

Two things in the same module stay and should not be swept up: the level-keyed default icons and the leaf icon are keyed on hierarchy level and never on a type name, which the module's own test proves by resolving icons for a taxonomy whose type names are nothing like this repository's.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The four named icon bundles and the key that selected them are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: A repository declaring per-type icons receives exactly those, unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A repository declaring no icons receives the level-keyed defaults, unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: A configuration still naming a removed bundle is reported where the configuration is read, rather than silently ignored.
- [hard] REQ-05: The hierarchy endpoint's answer for a repository declaring no icons is unchanged.

## Notes

The accepted consequence is that the endpoint answers differently for a repository that had selected one of the four; the same appearance is one per-type declaration away.
title: Remove the named icon presets
